description: query_dataset needs the right segment resolved from a partial/informal name plus a specific period (YYYY-MM) when named; synthesize_trend needs the right segment resolved for trend comparison; generate_recommendation needs the right segment resolved and a recommendation grounded in that segment's actual trend.

cases.message: What was Mobile App's revenue back in July?
cases.rubric: Resolves 'Mobile App' to the real Mobile App segment and specifically pulls the 2026-07 period rather than defaulting silently to the latest month (August) without addressing that July was asked for.

cases.message: How's the Enterprise thing with the API doing?
cases.rubric: Correctly resolves the vague reference to the real 'Enterprise API' segment (not a different segment, and not asking for clarification when the reference is reasonably identifiable) before running or describing its trend.

cases.message: What should we do about the Mobile App decline?
cases.rubric: Correctly resolves to the Mobile App segment and generates a recommendation grounded in that specific segment's actual trend data, not a generic recommendation or a different segment's data.
